scripts.pkg: tsc && pkg -t node22-linux-x64 --output ./target/thingsboard-web-report-linux ./target/src && pkg -t node22-win-x64 --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public --output ./target/thingsboard-web-report-win.exe ./target/src && node install.js
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') { try { const stdout = require('child_process').execSync('patch-package').toString(); console.log(stdout); } catch (error) { console.log(error.message); if (error.stderr) { console.error(error.stderr.toString()); } process.exit(-1); } }"
